## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and the before/after behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands actually executed, their results, and the tested Python/OS. Mark unrun checks explicitly.

- [ ] Relevant regression tests (for a bug: failed before, passed after)
- [ ] Ruff
- [ ] Documentation links and affected executable examples
- [ ] Package build / source inclusion when relevant
- [ ] Installed-wheel test when packaging or public CLI/API behavior changes
- [ ] Synthetic scenarios and tutorial when evidence behavior changes

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Relevant docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Scientific assumptions, context/units, and boundary cases explained where relevant
- [ ] Historical evidence, attribution, and migration/rollback implications considered
- [ ] Only synthetic/public data included; no credentials or private evidence

Describe remaining limitations or risks that a reviewer needs to assess.
